topics.headline: Oil rebound post-ceasefire collapse threatens both US and Eurozone July inflation
topics.summary: US CPI (3.5%) and Eurozone HICP (2.8%) both decelerated in June as an Iran ceasefire crashed oil prices, but the ceasefire has since broken down and Brent has surged back toward $85-plus, raising real risk that both readings reaccelerate in their next releases (US CPI Aug 12, Eurozone flash July 31).

topics.headline: HY spreads near multi-decade tights despite rising Fed hike odds
topics.summary: HY OAS sits at 2.71%, well below its 20-year average, even as CME FedWatch odds of a hike jumped from 18% to 36% in under two weeks; most desks expect modest widening but no imminent break, with the Sherman Ratio (70bps cushion) and heavy oversubscription on new deals suggesting spreads likely stay range-bound over the next 30 days barring a geopolitical or credit shock.

topics.headline: Bitcoin ETF flows whipsaw as Monday's $425M outflow snaps recovery
topics.summary: After two weeks of tentative inflows broke an 8-week, $8B+ outflow streak, Monday saw the biggest single-day outflow of July ($425M), while IBIT's rotation and only 54% retail long positioning suggest the fragile recovery is not yet confirmed.

topics.headline: Microsoft-Chevron 2.67GW gas PPA anchors surging hyperscaler power deal wave
topics.summary: Microsoft just signed a 20-year PPA with Chevron subsidiary Energy Forge One for a ~2.67 GW Texas data center campus, landing amid a dense cluster of fresh hyperscaler power deals (National Grid-Joulent, Digital Realty-Kansas City, Meta-Reliance) that easily satisfies this question; the deeper debate is now whether announced GW actually gets built on time.
